requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model for prescription records that includes provider NPI, drug identifier, prescription volume, and reporting period fields.
The system must enforce that provider NPI is a valid 10-digit numeric string in the Pydantic schema.
The system must include a field for standardized drug code (e.g., NDC or equivalent) in the prescription schema.
The system must define a MongoDB collection schema that persists prescription records with indexed provider NPI and drug code fields.
The system must define a mapping structure that links drug codes to one or more ICD-10 condition codes.
The system must enforce that all ICD-10 codes in the mapping conform to valid ICD-10 format patterns.
The system must support one-to-many relationships between a single drug code and multiple ICD-10 conditions in the schema.
The system must define a normalized output contract for prescription appropriateness scoring including provider NPI, condition, score value, and confidence.
The system must ensure the normalized score field is constrained to a numeric range between 0 and 1.
The system must include metadata fields in the schema indicating data source (e.g., Medicare Part D) and ingestion timestamp.
The system must reject prescription records that are missing required fields (NPI, drug code, or volume) during validation.
The system must raise a validation error when an invalid ICD-10 code is provided in the drug-condition mapping.
The system must allow extensibility in the schema to support additional drug classification systems without breaking existing models.
The system must define versioning for the schema and output contract to support backward compatibility.
